# PSD donor fixtures

These five binary fixtures are extracted byte-for-byte from the hexadecimal
arrays in `imageio/tests/resourcesInclude/{r,al,rgb,rgba,rgbRle}.psd.h`.
The expected dimensions and corner pixels come from
`imageio/tests/TestPsdHandler.cpp`. Copyright 2014 CCP ehf.; retained as
the original Carbon handler's regression fixtures.
